title: Vietnamese-Style Crispy Shrimp with Fresh Papelon Salad
description: A fusion of Italian and Vietnamese flavors in this refreshing summer dish, featuring crispy fried shrimp, crunchy papelon slaw, and a sprinkle of fresh herbs.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together papelon, mi, garlic, and chili flakes (if using).
2. Add shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
3. Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Remove the shrimp from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
5. Fry the shrimp until golden brown and cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side.
6. Transfer the shrimp to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. In a separate bowl, combine cucumber and cilantro.
8. To assemble the dish, place a portion of the papelon-mi slaw on a plate, followed by a few pieces of fried shrimp, and top with the cucumber-cilantro mixture.
10. Garnish with additional cilantro and a sprinkle of chili flakes (if desired)
